title: Adjacent heartbeat-increment magnitude correlation improves age-transfer point estimates but does not establish robust incremental prediction
abstract: Adding adjacent absolute RR-increment correlation to conventional HRV and linear-dependence controls reduced age-group transfer logloss by 0.110820 from Fantasia to NSR2 and 0.124884 in reverse. Source-plus-target bootstrap95% intervals were [-0.024051, 0.409800] and [-0.199841, 0.550636]. Both crossed zero; winsorization reversed the reverse-transfer gain. This exploratory reused-data analysis does not establish a robust aging biomarker or verified participant-disjoint validation.
